palette.notes: 9 colours measured, 2 short ramps (length 4.5, no hue shift). Yellow and blue kit, green grass, grey year text on white.

lighting: Flat; no cast light, only a light-to-dark band on the grass edge.
silhouette: One small kneeling player, hands on face, dark outline; the pose reads at tiny size.

motion.timing: Almost no animation: 4 changes in 19.58 s, holds median 5800 ms. The whole clip is long held beats; the year label changes 2026, 2022, 2018, 2014.

texture: Clean pixels, chunky grass edge with darker speckle, blocky pixel font for the years.
camera: Locked wide frame; the grass drops away and the white then black background takes over at the end.

acting.enters: The kneeling player is there from the start.
acting.acts: He holds the same grieving pose while a faded ghost of his past self appears beside him for each earlier World Cup year.
acting.exits: The ground goes, the reflection fades, and he is left alone on black at the end.
acting.depth: Ghosts are translucent copies on the same plane; the end isolates him small in an empty frame.

techniques: one held pose; the story told by changing text and ghosts
translucent past-self ghost next to the present character
count-down year labels as the beat
background removed at the end to isolate the hero
feel: one held sad pose + ghost of the past + years counting back = big emotion with almost no frames
for_fred: Not every beat needs motion: hold Fred in one strong pose for a few seconds and change the world around him (text, a ghost copy, the background dropping away). Saves animation for when it counts.
